name: @lyku/para-sync
description: synced<T> distributed object sync for the para:* suite: server-authoritative records with live, version-reconciled client replicas. Pre-release: API may change before 0.1.0. Provides the pluggable SyncTransport interface (InProcessTransport + NatsTransport), the client-side reconciler (createClientReplica), and the synced() reactive primitive that composes them with a change-stream bridge.
